description: Test cases for classification accuracy - target >80%

test_cases.problem: We spend hours every month copying data from 5 different spreadsheets into a summary report for management.
Our sales team uses a complex Excel spreadsheet to create customer quotes. Only Sarah knows how to update the formulas and it breaks when she's on holiday.
We keep running out of stock on popular items and overstocking slow movers. We need to predict what to order.
We have 10 years of customer purchase data but don't know who our best customers are or which ones might leave.
New employees spend weeks searching through our policy documents and SOPs. We wish they could just ask questions and get answers.
Every invoice that comes in, someone has to manually enter the details into our accounting system. It takes 2 hours a day.
We have data in Salesforce, QuickBooks, Google Sheets, and a custom access database. None of them talk to each other.
I want to use AI
Our finance team creates the same cash flow report every week, pulling numbers from the bank and two other systems.
We track all our projects in a Google Sheet with 50 tabs. It crashes and formulas break regularly.
test_cases.notes: Overloaded spreadsheet as project management tool

test_cases.problem: We need to know how many staff to roster for each day based on expected customer traffic.
Our sales reps don't know which leads to call first. We want to prioritize based on likelihood to close.
Engineers keep asking the same questions about our technical documentation. We have 500 pages of manuals.
When a customer emails a support request, someone has to copy it into Zendesk, tag it, and route it to the right team.
We don't know what data we have or where it lives. Everything is in different places.
Something with data
Every quarter we compile a board report with KPIs from 8 different systems. It takes a full week.
Our pricing is calculated in a master spreadsheet. When we add new products, someone has to manually update all the linked sheets.
We want to predict which machines will break down before they fail so we can do preventive maintenance.
We have no idea which customers are likely to renew their contracts and which are at risk.
Our HR team answers the same policy questions 50 times a week. All the answers are in the employee handbook.
Files arrive in a shared folder and need to be renamed, moved to the right location, and logged in a tracker.
Our data is messy and we don't trust the numbers. Before we can do anything useful, we need to clean it up.
Can you help with my business?
We export data from our CRM every day, combine it with marketing data, and create a dashboard in Google Sheets. It's all manual.
